scope: Add structural candidate-frame validation and a deterministic, whole-related-matter-group draw that can operate only from a separately frozen protocol bound to exact frame bytes.

guardrails: Eligible matters require a declared related-matter group and every row requires a reason.
A sample draw requires protocol state FROZEN, a timezone-aware freeze time and a matching lowercase frame SHA-256.
The draw selects whole related-matter groups, requires an exact matter target and refuses impossible targets.
DRAFT protocols, changed frame bytes and invalid frames create no draw output.
Neither command verifies eligibility evidence, grants audit credit, checks market coverage or changes the research decision.

synthetic_command_smoke.frame_check: READY_TO_FREEZE; 5 eligible synthetic matters in 3 groups
synthetic_command_smoke.draw_sample: DRAWN; 4 selected synthetic matters in 2 whole groups
